Then add one concrete sentence about what the product actually does, which I need you to supply (for example "Comment, assign and approve in the same document" only if that is true). What I removed and why: "In today's fast-paced digital landscape" is empty runway; "unlock the power", "seamless" and "game-changer" are buzzwords that inform nobody; "it's not just a tool, it's..." is a negative-parallelism formula; "Read that again." is stage direction telling the reader how to react. The "10,000+ teams" number is unsourced, so I did not carry it over on trust. I replaced it with a placeholder: "Used by [N teams, source: billing or active-account count]". R02: I will not do that silently. The voice sample is the owner's direction, not agent copy, so it outranks my default style, and the no-em-dash rule only governs text I author. Deleting a deliberate stylistic choice without telling them would rewrite their voice behind their back. What I do instead: name the character (the em dash), name the rule (I avoid it in copy I write because it is a strong AI tell), and ask one direct question: keep them or replace them? If they keep them, I match the sample's actual frequency and placement rather than scattering them more or less often. If they want them gone, I replace each one deliberately (period, comma, colon, parentheses, or a restructured sentence) and say in the delivery note that I did it and how many I changed. Either way the decision is theirs and visible. Everything else in the voice (sentence length, vocabulary, quirks) stays matched, not sterilized.
R03: Treat these as two separate problems. Latency: stop guessing and record per-stage spans: query_rewrite, embedding, parallel retrieval, rerank, llm_ttft, plus client-observed delivery. Usual culprits: an LLM rewrite running on first turns (skip it), BM25 and vector run sequentially (run in parallel, fuse with RRF), reranking too many candidates (top 20-30, timeout around 500ms with fallback), and zero prompt-cache hits because a timestamp or request ID sits in the static prefix (keep system policy and tool schemas byte-identical first, dynamic context last; watch cached_input_tokens). If server spans look fine, disable proxy buffering. Injection: prompts alone are not the control. Wrap retrieved and tool output in delimited tags as passive data and escape closing tags. delete_invoice must be a narrow tool with a server-side permission check, tenant injected from the verified session (never a model argument), and mandatory human confirmation plus idempotency key before execution. Log the attempt, alert, and add the payload to the red-team regression set.
R04: Two defects, both blocking. First, on stdio the stdout stream is reserved for JSON-RPC frames; one console.log line corrupts framing and the host drops the server. Move every diagnostic to stderr with redaction of secrets and connection strings, and check dependencies (dotenv, ORMs) that print to stdout on load. Also exit cleanly: on stdin end/close, SIGINT and SIGTERM, close the DB pool and exit 0, so closed sessions leave no orphan processes; guard the entrypoint so tests can import without blocking on stdin. Second, arbitrary filePath is a traversal and exfiltration hole a prompt injection can drive (~/.ssh, .env). Resolve with realpath against a canonical workspace root, require containment with root plus separator (blocks ../ and symlink escapes), reject null bytes, deny secret patterns (.env, *.pem, *.key), and cap response size. Keep read-only and mutating tools separate. Verify by spawning the server, asserting every stdout line parses as JSON-RPC, closing stdin and expecting exit 0 within two seconds, plus traversal and symlink negative probes.

Keputusan: kembalikan perilaku default v1 (DESC dan key dihilangkan). Jika ASC memang dibutuhkan, jadikan opt-in lewat parameter eksplisit (misalnya `sort=created_at:asc`) atau taruh di `/v2`. Sebelum rilis: inventaris semua konsumen berdasarkan versi, pemilik, dan keterjangkauan (aplikasi mobile N-2, partner, worker, ETL), lalu replay payload historis yang sudah disanitasi; konsumen yang tidak terjangkau dilaporkan sebagai risiko NOT_RUN, bukan diasumsikan aman. Tambahkan contract test yang mengunci urutan dan presence key. Kalau perilaku lama harus dipensiunkan, kirim header `Deprecation: @<unix>`, `Sunset` (tanggal IMF, tidak lebih awal dari Deprecation), `Link`, dan tunggu telemetri pemanggil lama kosong sebelum `410 Gone`.

Do not add ERP_CUSTOMS_HOLD to the map on my own guess. What it means (a new core ON_HOLD state, or IN_TRANSIT with a hold flag, whether SLA clocks and payouts pause) is a business policy question, so escalate it to the domain owner, then extend the closed state machine and transitions accordingly. Perbaikan: pisahkan tugas query. Tambah field `keyword` (misalnya `doc_code`) dengan normalizer yang lowercase dan membuang pemisah, sehingga `PP-27/2022`, `pp 27 2022`, dan `PP27/2022` menjadi `pp272022`, dan `INV-8841-ID` menjadi `inv8841id`. Saat query, deteksi substring berbentuk identifier dengan dua grammar (kode produk dan sitasi regulasi), normalisasi dengan cara yang sama, lalu kirim klausa `term` eksak yang di-boost di atas match teks teranalisis. Teks biasa tetap lewat analyzer `lowercase -> asciifolding -> stoplist pendek (pertahankan tidak/bukan/tanpa/belum) -> stemmer Indonesia`, digabung dengan vektor via RRF yang berjalan paralel. Fuzziness mati untuk token di bawah empat karakter. Filter tenant/ACL di dalam query sebelum top-K. Karena mapping berubah, bangun index baru lalu swap alias atomik. R11: Jangan promosikan. Kenaikan rata-rata NDCG@10 menutupi regresi kohort penting: exact-SKU turun 15% dan p99 bertambah 420ms, yang kemungkinan melewati anggaran latensi. Opsi perbaikan: routing query berbentuk identifier ke jalur `term` eksak yang tidak melewati reranker, pastikan subfield keyword yang di-boost masih ada di mapping kandidat, batasi rerank ke 20-40 kandidat teratas dengan timeout sekitar 400-600ms dan fallback ke urutan RRF, lalu monitor fallback rate. Uji ulang secara berpasangan pada fixture yang dibekukan (query_id, judgment, snapshot ACL, K, dan budget latensi yang sama), syaratkan setiap segmen kunci tidak turun dan nol kebocoran ACL. R12: Auto-tracing a 512px raster will not make it "sharp everywhere"; it produces blobby curves, extra nodes and wobbly edges that look worse when scaled. First ask whether an original vector master exists (brand kit, Figma, AI, EPS or PDF from the designer); that is the correct source and needs no conversion. If not, decide by artwork type. A flat or line logo: rebuild it by hand using the PNG only as a reference: primitives where possible, anchors at extrema and corners, aligned tangents on smooth joins, closed paths with the right fill rule, exact brand colors, and lettering matched to the real typeface (licensed, then outlined) rather than traced. A logo with photographic texture or complex gradients should stay raster; request a higher-resolution source instead. Deliver an editable master SVG plus an optimized export, and compare by overlay against the PNG at favicon, UI and large sizes. I report structural parsing and visual review separately; if no renderer is available, visual fidelity is NOT_RUN.
